Do not return hashes; the host binds immutable hashes.", "context": {"title": "David Copperfield", "unit": 47, "heading": "CHAPTER 45. MR. DICK FULFILS MY AUNT’S PREDICTIONS", "previous_rows": [{"source_id": "en85-u047-b0126", "target": "— Ещё немного! Совсем немного слов! Мне случалось думать, что есть столько женщин, на которых вы могли бы жениться и которые не навлекли бы на вас такой обузы и такого беспокойства и сделали бы ваш дом более достойным домом. Мне случалось бояться, что лучше бы мне оставаться вашей ученицей и почти вашим ребёнком. Мне случалось страшиться, что я так не подхожу к вашей учёности и мудрости. Если всё это заставляло меня замыкаться в себе (а так оно и было), когда мне предстояло рассказать об этом, то всё равно потому, что я так чтила вас и надеялась, что когда-нибудь вы почтите меня.", "source_sha256": "7b8148fb9c53db555ccbff49575d014913be597ff91fe88e5b7b7ae200dc999b", "target_id": "ru-en85-u047-b0126", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "1036f6e387a78dac637153c454329436d30e61043b3decf40e7a8e7d16aaff29"}, {"source_id": "en85-u047-b0127", "target": "— Этот день сияет уже давно, Энни, — сказал Доктор, — и ночь у него может быть лишь одна, долгая, моя дорогая.", "source_sha256": "5cf37380e80489f4db96c73a5138087a1e7339fbb7784d4930715b0718891be9", "target_id": "ru-en85-u047-b0127", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "e30d1677b74de907e62df7ade01ccb1ae07e06a183fa02cec9db05e733949c2d"}], "source_language": "English", "part": null, "book": null, "chapter": 45, "role": "chapter"}, "source_rows": [{"id": "en85-u047-b0128", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Another word! I afterwards meant—steadfastly meant, and purposed to myself—to bear the whole weight of knowing the unworthiness of one to whom you had been so good. And now a last word, dearest and best of friends! The cause of the late change in you, which I have seen with so much pain and sorrow, and have sometimes referred to my old apprehension—at other times to lingering suppositions nearer to the truth—has been made clear tonight; and by an accident I have also come to know, tonight, the full measure of your noble trust in me, even under that mistake. I do not hope that any love and duty I may render in return, will ever make me worthy of your priceless confidence; but with all this knowledge fresh upon me, I can lift my eyes to this dear face, revered as a father’s, loved as a husband’s, sacred to me in my childhood as a friend’s, and solemnly declare that in my lightest thought I have never wronged you; never wavered in the love and the fidelity I owe you!’", "sha256": "20647549613d14eb66b7a52bf4728dfa617923ece61609b6defe9e8ca9960fb9", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[52]/p[129]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u047-b0129", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "She had her arms around the Doctor’s neck, and he leant his head down over her, mingling his grey hair with her dark brown tresses.", "sha256": "f4270987c36016fd36d2c62491f217b65bd8891664027ffa41ee624708733112", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[52]/p[130]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u047-b0130", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Oh, hold me to your heart, my husband! Never cast me out! Do not think or speak of disparity between us, for there is none, except in all my many imperfections. Every succeeding year I have known this better, as I have esteemed you more and more. Oh, take me to your heart, my husband, for my love was founded on a rock, and it endures!’", "sha256": "8ba5e8e96a307d67308d9f1bc4ce5f3f9ca0686706c67e07703c18dcbcf79e10", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[52]/p[131]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u047-b0131", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "In the silence that ensued, my aunt walked gravely up to Mr. Dick, without at all hurrying herself, and gave him a hug and a sounding kiss. And it was very fortunate, with a view to his credit, that she did so; for I am confident that I detected him at that moment in the act of making preparations to stand on one leg, as an appropriate expression of delight.", "sha256": "64cf75929a0f1165e36bf673a484ce1ae42ca640bbd81bec06889b9c37b16d0e", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[52]/p[132]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u047-b0132", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘You are a very remarkable man, Dick!’ said my aunt, with an air of unqualified approbation; ‘and never pretend to be anything else, for I know better!’", "sha256": "31a7a9ee3fedff43c1d09c4e8c463185269a48cad44676ee9d67d898f946cb20", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[52]/p[133]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u047-b0133", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "With that, my aunt pulled him by the sleeve, and nodded to me; and we three stole quietly out of the room, and came away.", "sha256": "75f751d190578aa7d79fdd943491b285401989d35988cccad9c30099340fafc3", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[52]/p[134]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u047-b0134", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘That’s a settler for our military friend, at any rate,’ said my aunt, on the way home. ‘I should sleep the better for that, if there was nothing else to be glad of!’", "sha256": "23a9b45c473634a19341459b061f89fef695b8e8ea279ddcd6acda2afaa8b9b7", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[52]/p[135]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u047-b0135", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘She was quite overcome, I am afraid,’ said Mr. Dick, with great commiseration.", "sha256": "400cbf3ec5c34e9590a11ce81bc91511de98f19c32383204adbd85646dcd1c2b", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[52]/p[136]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u047-b0136", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘What! Did you ever see a crocodile overcome?’ inquired my aunt.", "sha256": "57ec55f19b3e14acc7fecd65ec200183496c9337dc33b22d0092e8a63913b984", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[52]/p[137]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u047-b0137", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘I don’t think I ever saw a crocodile,’ returned Mr. Dick, mildly.", "sha256": "1160920a539415e46c27701d536f84b8bcbacfa1e6eddd5f71cdffa0652b3d79", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[52]/p[138]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u047-b0138", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘There never would have been anything the matter, if it hadn’t been for that old Animal,’ said my aunt, with strong emphasis. ‘It’s very much to be wished that some mothers would leave their daughters alone after marriage, and not be so violently affectionate. They seem to think the only return that can be made them for bringing an unfortunate young woman into the world—God bless my soul, as if she asked to be brought, or wanted to come!—is full liberty to worry her out of it again. What are you thinking of, Trot?’", "sha256": "19c30658027bdad0d03ebc9cb48aa321b2d1ac9f3bec4bd975322111bf20dcc9", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[52]/p[139]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u047-b0139", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "I was thinking of all that had been said. My mind was still running on some of the expressions used. ‘There can be no disparity in marriage like unsuitability of mind and purpose.’ ‘The first mistaken impulse of an undisciplined heart.’ ‘My love was founded on a rock.’ But we were at home; and the trodden leaves were lying under-foot, and the autumn wind was blowing.", "sha256": "665f783244aa889794c3d804bc556b76e56d3bf85e4ac3a15c270509971f2470", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[52]/p[140]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}]}
